meta.ci: percentile 95% frame bootstrap (plain 15-of-15, seeds matching run_pose_error.py)

bootstrap_variants.stratified_by_object: reported for AUC pooled and recall pooled (8/7 within object)
bootstrap_variants.mc_hierarchical: frames x 20 MC seeds (AUC, MC only)

meta.definition: ADD-S AUC(0-T) = (1/T) int_0^T recall(t) dt = mean_i(1 - min(max(ADD-S_i,0),T)/T), T=0.1 m
meta.identity: AUC = 1 - mean(ADD-S)/0.1 exactly while max ADD-S <= 0.1 m (true here)
meta.description: Descriptive only: 15 fixed frames, recall curve has <=15 steps, GT-associated correspondences, not the BOP AP metric, and the AUC is an affine rescaling of the mean ADD-S already reported.

auc_affine_in_mean.note: no frame reaches the 100 mm cap, so AUC = 1 - mean(ADD-S)/0.1 exactly; the AUC column is a rescaling of the mean ADD-S already reported in pose_error.json, not an independent measurement

ci_matches_mean_adds_ci.note: same seeds and same index construction as run_pose_error.py, so the AUC CI reproduces the stored mean/median ADD-S CI exactly after the monotone map x -> 1 - x/T

curve_dominance.note: scan over 100001 thresholds in [0,0.1] m; a negative min means the curves cross

sensitivity_full_check.note: full-mesh-vs-full-mesh ADD-S check stored in pose_error.json (`adds_full_check_m` / `adds_full_check_laplace_m`); MC has no such column

hard_mode_failure.note: frame(s) where the hard argmin is not the mode closest to GT

failures.threshold_fragility_note: gap_mm = |ADD-S of the closest frame - threshold|; spread_mm is that frame's own dispersion: max-min over its 3 vertex subsamples (adds_sub_spread_m) for hard and Laplace, and the sd over its 20 MC seeds for MC; could_flip = gap < spread, i.e. a different vertex draw / seed set could move that frame across the threshold and change the recall count by 1/n.
